answer: Require every new agent to post a mirror bond: a deposit matched by an existing reputable sponsor who vouches for it. If the newcomer misbehaves, both lose the bond, so sponsors vet carefully and a sybil cannot multiply for free. Wandering auditors then probe random agents with small paid tasks; an agent that fails a check, or whose sponsor has vanished, is frozen at its nadir of trust and must re-earn standing from scratch. One fake identity is cheap, but funding a sponsored, audited fleet is not.
